mission.title: Disturbing Trends
mission.description: Find out where Morpheus is from one of his friends.

npc.say: Bring me the Machines' info node map, then maybe I'll know I can trust you.
Don't forget where the real power lies in the Matrix.

Huh, looks like you're on our side after all. Well then, here's what I know about Morpheus: he wants to find Neo's body, or what's left of it, and return it to Zion. Seems kind of morbid to me, but that's Morpheus for you.

phase.briefing: The Zion operative Morpheus is conducting unacceptably disruptive activities inside the Matrix. We require you to interrogate one of his friends in order to ascertain his current whereabouts.

enter.say: The friend of Morpheus is in that building. She calls herself Ophiuchi. Find out what she knows about Morpheus, but remember that the Truce forbids the use of force against humans.

talk.say: So you'd like to know about Morpheus, would you? Tell you what--if you can prove that you're on our side, I'll tell you what I know. Let's see... Ah, I've got it. There's a Machine operations post nearby. Break into it, steal the local info node map off of their internal network, and bring it to me. Then we'll talk. Your operator will know where to find me.

done.say: Little does this human realize that the data she is asking for is relatively worthless. This is an acceptable exchange. Leave the area and I will direct you to the operations post.

phase.briefing: Our operations post is nearby. I will mark the position with a waypoint.

enter.say: The operations post is inside that building. The Agents have been notified of your arrival. You will find the info node Map Disk on one of the computers.
The Map Disk is accessible from a computer in this room.

objective.text: Get the Map Disk from the computer

done.say: Take that disk to Ophiuchi. I will mark her current location with a waypoint once you've left this area.

phase.briefing: Ophiuchi's current waypoint has been uploaded to you. Proceed there now.

enter.say: Ophiuchi can be found inside that building. Give her the Map Disk and get her information about Morpheus.

objective.text: Give the Map Disk to Ophiuchi

talk.say: Well, so you made it back. Did you manage to steal the info node map?

done.say: Your work is done there, operative.

Huh, looks like you're on our side after all. Well then, here's what I know about Morpheus: he wants to find Neo's body, or what's left of it, and return it to Zion. Seems kind of morbid to me, but that's Morpheus for you.

mission.finish: Human attitudes about cessation of awareness are puzzling. Nevertheless, this information about Morpheus' intentions may be of some use in locating him.
